notes: Metres, Z up, front -X. Applied transforms in the shared prop frame. Cycles CPU 64-sample diffuse COLOR times (0.4 + 0.6 AO), sRGB8 albedo; PBR and artwork packed in source.blend. DejaVu Sans Bold, English only. Task 15 uses isolated finalization to protect existing props. Body is 50 mm high, clear interior 47 mm; 3 mm lid above it makes the closed assembly 53 mm. Body centre is X+5 mm so the 10 mm front projection yields an assembly bottom-centre origin. Main lid and horizontal 10 mm extension are one 110 mm slab, plus the 8 mm downward return. Positive +Y hinge rotation lifts the -X front. No contact exclusion disables lid closing contact. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification.
